name: Epic of Gilgamesh
description:
You wield artifacts that demand quests to unlock their true potential. Non-ultimate quests must be completed 3 times to upgrade. Ultimate quest must be completed 5 times.

Sun-forged Scimitar: 5 Successful Attacks against gods while Ignited.
Drop Kick: Drop Kick a target into a god.
Hero's Advance: Kill or Assist gods affected by Hero's Advance damage bonus.
Winds of Shamash: Knockback a target off the wall.

• Each quest: 100 gold + upgrade

name: Sun-forged Scimitar
description:
Ignite your sword for 3s. Enemies around the ignition take Physical Damage and are Slowed for 2s.

• Lane minions take increased damage
• Your Attacks deal bonus Physical Damage based on your max Health and extend the effect per hit
• You gain HP5 per rank
• Quest Upgrade: Initial ignition extends buff on enemy hits; max duration +3s

name: Drop Kick
description:
Drop kick an area in front of you, dealing Physical Damage to enemies. The closest enemy is launched through them, taking bonus Physical Damage when hitting a minion or burst Physical Damage and Stunned when hitting a god or wall. Launched enemies hitting Winds of Shamash are Knocked Back toward the center of the ring.

• Quest Upgrade: When Stun fades, targets are Intoxicated

name: Hero's Advance
description:
Leap to a target location, dealing Physical Damage on impact. Create a beacon for 5s.

• Center sweet spot applies increased Damage to enemies
• Allies moving toward the beacon gain Movement Speed, halved once inside
• Quest Upgrade: The beacon now travels with you

name: Winds of Shamash
description:
Call the winds of Shamash at a target location for 6s. Enemies inside at start take Physical Damage and are Slowed for 2s. Enemies in the ring take Physical Damage every 0.5s. Outer wall heavily Slows; your damage Pulls them to center. At 6s, wind becomes thread, dealing additional Physical Damage and Rooting those inside.

• Quest Upgrade: Ticks every 0.375s and the outer wall Slow increases to 70%

name: Gilgamesh Basic Attack
description: Deal Physical Damage to an enemy in front of you.
